method: Playwright CLI attached to the built Electron application over CDP and browsing the running Next.js application. Complete application viewports; no element crops, pixel editing, DOM text changes, CSS changes, or compositing.
dataScope: Explicit screenshot fixtures in a disposable Git repository and SQLite profile. Four local Runs, 15 artifacts, 3 reviews, 7 illustrative stage-usage records and 2 authored conversations. Three TestEvidence records contain actual sample-project test output: 14 passing checks. Desktop is unpaired; fixture outbox entries were cleared before launch. Normal API endpoints received redacted example summaries in an isolated in-memory demo repository, using its synthetic identity. No paid model calls, real GitHub delivery, existing user profile, or production data.
